assistiveTechnologyTests.procedure: Complete the journey and listen for the announcement or information under test.

title: Combobox active descendant points at a filtered-out option
description: Typing filters the suggestion list. The alpha combobox keeps aria-activedescendant on Mallard after Mallard is hidden, so assistive technology reports a suggestion that is no longer available.

relatedElements.note: The control moves the active descendant to the first visible option.

expectedBehaviour: The active descendant always references an option that is present and visible in the list.
actualBehaviour: The reference remains on the hidden Mallard option after filtering.
userImpact: Screen-reader users hear the wrong suggestion and cannot tell which option they would select.

detection.note: The roles and names are valid; only the reference becomes stale after input.

observed.note: Page-level axe run with tags wcag2a, wcag2aa, wcag21a, wcag21aa and best-practice. No violation was reported in the default state; the control on the same page or path also passes.

manualTests: Type mag in the species field and listen to which suggestion is announced as active.

assertions: aria-activedescendant still references the hidden Mallard option after typing mag.
tests: tests/subtle-widgets.spec.js: keeps the alpha active descendant on a filtered-out option

reviewStatus.note: A Playwright regression test preserves the defective journey or widget behaviour and its control. That is automated reproduction, not a manual or assistive-technology observation.
